howto.name: Upload a MOV
howto.text: Drop a QuickTime .mov file, the format iPhone cameras and Mac screen recordings use.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. FFmpeg re-encodes the video as H.264 and the audio as AAC in an MP4 — widely playable.

faq.a: MOV is Apple's QuickTime format. While Macs play it natively, Windows, Android, and most streaming platforms prefer MP4. The codecs inside are often the same (H.264), but this tool re-encodes the video anyway rather than only changing the container.
A little. Every file is re-encoded as H.264 at CRF 23 with AAC audio instead of being copied, so the result is not bit-for-bit the original.
Yes, re-encoded as AAC. If the file has several audio tracks, only one is kept.
